title: Go: Struct Embedding
description: Use Go's struct embedding to compose types through promoted fields and methods.

steps.title: Embed a struct in a struct
steps.description: Define a `Address` struct with `City` and `Zip` fields. Embed it in a `Person` struct. Create a `Person` and access the City field directly. Print the city.
hints: Embed by adding the type name without a field name
Promoted fields are accessed directly: `p.City` not `p.Address.City`

verification.successMessage: Struct embedding promotes the inner type's fields!
verification.failureMessage: Embed Address without a field name inside Person.

steps.title: Promoted fields
steps.description: Embed a `Base` struct with fields `ID` and `CreatedAt` into `User` and `Admin` structs. Create both and print their `ID` and `CreatedAt` directly.
hints: Promoted fields are accessible as if they were defined on the outer struct
This works for any depth of embedding
Multiple embedded structs can promote fields with different names

verification.successMessage: Promoted fields shared by multiple types!
verification.failureMessage: Access ID directly on User and Admin without going through Base.

steps.title: Method promotion
steps.description: Define a `Logger` struct with a method `Log(msg string)` that prints "LOG: " + msg. Embed Logger in `Service`. Call `Log` on a Service instance directly.
hints: Methods on embedded types are promoted like fields
`s.Log("msg")` works even though Service doesn't define Log

verification.successMessage: Methods are promoted just like fields!
verification.failureMessage: Embed Logger in Service and call Log directly.

steps.title: Overriding methods
steps.description: Embed a `Base` struct with a method `Greet()` that returns "Hello from Base". Define a `Derived` struct embedding Base, with its own `Greet()` returning "Hello from Derived". Call Greet on both. Print the results.
hints: The outer struct's method takes priority over the embedded type's method
This is method "overriding" via shadowing, not inheritance

verification.test: output.includes('Hello from Derived') && output.includes('Hello from Base')
verification.failureMessage: Print both the outer and inner Greet results.

steps.title: Embedded interface
steps.description: Define an interface `Reader` with method `Read() string` and a struct `File` that implements it. Embed the Reader interface in `BufferedFile`. Implement Read on BufferedFile to add "buffered: " prefix. Print the result.
hints: Interfaces can be embedded in structs too
To satisfy the embedded interface, the outer struct must implement all methods
The outer implementation wraps the inner type's method

verification.successMessage: Interface embedding in structs is powerful!
verification.failureMessage: Implement the Read method on BufferedFile.
